narratives.Overview:
1. **Prefer-A defer short-circuit (primary).** In `evaluateFinalizeOwedSessionGate`, when `deferOwedReason` is non-empty, do **not** call `discoverFinalizeOwed` / `fetchDeliveryTipPrivate` on the blocking inventory path. Record deferred ritual lines (`finalize owed deferred: <reason>` + soft `finalize_owed` state) and continue. Match the existing `--defer=doctor` / `--defer=cache_fresh` skip pattern (`includeDoctor` / `includeCacheFresh`). Keep undeferred starts fail-closed with the existing remediation text.

2. **Dest leaf ceremony guidance.** In swarm skill and/or host-grok-build / preamble: prefer `session:start --rearm` when dest `.deft/ritual-state.json` already exists; keep audited `--defer-owed=<reason>` and `--defer=cache_fresh=…`; do not launch N dest cold tip inventories at once while the gate is still scan-first (serialize ceremony, or rely on Prefer-A). Primary ritual does not satisfy dest hooks — dest still needs its own ritual, but must not re-pay full owed discovery when defer applies.

3. **Regression test for cost, not only soft-pass.** Extend `session-start-finalize-owed.test.ts` (or adjacent) so defer with a live-path spy proves `fetchDeliveryTipPrivate` / `discoverFinalizeOwed` are **not** called (no network/tip thrash). Soft-pass-only under injected `probeFinalizeOwed` is insufficient.

4. **Non-goals.** Do not raise `session:start` timeouts / hang-detector budgets to hide the scan. Do not auto-delete or cancel `#635` proposed briefs (separate operator clear). Do not reopen anonymous occupancy release / `#3954`. TTL inventory under `.deft/` remains a later option if undeferred concurrent stampede stays hot after Prefer-A; it is not first-ship.

Issue: deftai/directive#5145
Charter: refutation

Seat: grok. Launcher: grok.

Refutation target (Stop 1 5894222576): When --defer-owed=<reason> is present, running full discoverFinalizeOwed (tip fetch + nonterminal walk + PR admit) then soft-passing blocks is acceptable ceremony cost for session:start / --rearm and for concurrent dest leaves.

## Verdict

The refutation target does not survive.

## Existing mechanisms inventoried

- `evaluateFinalizeOwedSessionGate` (`packages/core/src/session/session-start.ts`): computes `deferReason` first; production path still always `fetchDeliveryTipPrivate` then `discoverFinalizeOwed`; `blocks` becomes `blocking && !deferred` only after that work.
- Cold and re-arm both call that gate (`// #4919: re-arm also runs the finalize-owed gate`).
- Sibling ritual deferrals already short-circuit work: `--defer=doctor` / `--defer=cache_fresh` set `includeDoctor: !doctorDeferred` / `includeCacheFresh: !cacheDeferred`.
- CLI parses `--defer-owed` / `--defer-owed=` into `deferOwedReason` (`packages/cli/src/session-start.ts`).
- Tests lock soft-pass of `blocks` under injected `probeFinalizeOwed`; they do not lock that discovery is skipped (`session-start-finalize-owed.test.ts`).
- `discoverFinalizeOwed` pays tip `ls-tree`, per-brief `git show`, open-PR `gh api`, and per-story `remoteClaimMeta` (`ls-remote` + private claim fetch).
- No `.deft/` TTL inventory cache found for finalize-owed.
- Preamble names `session:start --rearm` for stale-ritual recovery and `DEFT_SESSION_RITUAL_SKIP=1` for dispatched workers; swarm skill / host-grok-build do not teach dest `--rearm` + `--defer-owed` stampede avoidance.

## Defer soft-passes after full tip discovery
blocks-the-design
Evidence: At `41dbcbb5ae6ad182312d1fc624162d77cf1363f5`, `git show` of `evaluateFinalizeOwedSessionGate` shows `deferred` set from `deferOwedReason`, then unconditional `fetchDeliveryTipPrivate` + `discoverFinalizeOwed` on the live path (no `if (deferred)` early return). Issue current-state 5894222255 records parent rearm ~894s with `--defer-owed=…` then `finalize owed deferred: …`. Sibling `--defer=doctor|cache_fresh` already skips the deferred step body.
Failure mode: Operators treat `--defer-owed` as audited skip/reuse; ceremony still burns tip fetch + nonterminal walk + PR admit before soft-passing. Through-merge leaves sit in `session:start` for minutes while Bound remedy work has not started. Raising hang-detector / timeout budgets (issue non-goal) becomes the silent pressure valve.
Disposition: Bind Prefer-A: when `deferOwedReason` is non-empty, skip `discoverFinalizeOwed` / `fetchDeliveryTipPrivate` on the blocking inventory path; record deferred ritual lines; keep undeferred fail-closed. The acceptability premise cannot bind.

## Concurrent dest leaves re-pay the same tip inventory
blocks-the-design
Evidence: Same SHA: cold path and re-arm path each call `evaluateFinalizeOwedSessionGate`. `fetchDeliveryTipPrivate` writes per-clone `refs/deft/finalize-owed/<branch>`; each dest worktree is its own `projectRoot`. No shared inventory reuse under `.deft/`. Swarm / host-grok-build / preamble lack dest ceremony guidance that prefers `--rearm` when dest ritual exists and that avoids N concurrent cold tip inventories while the gate is scan-first. Injection/swarm lens: concurrency + worktrees + shared origin tip.
Failure mode: A five-leaf cohort with `--defer-owed` still launches five independent tip inventories against the same delivery tip. Wall-clock multiplies; operators see the cohort "stuck in session:start" even though every leaf already deferred the block.
Disposition: First-ship must pair the Prefer-A short-circuit with dest ceremony guidance (skill or preamble): prefer `--rearm` when dest `.deft/ritual-state.json` exists; keep audited `--defer-owed` / `--defer=cache_fresh`; do not stampede N cold owed tip scans under defer. Concurrent-leaves clause of the target fails with the parent rearm clause.

## Tests lock soft-pass, not cost
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `session-start-finalize-owed.test.ts` at the dispatch SHA asserts `blocks === false` and a deferred line when `deferOwedReason` is set under injected `probeFinalizeOwed`. The live production path that calls `fetchDeliveryTipPrivate` / `discoverFinalizeOwed` is unexercised for the defer short-circuit. Acceptance already names a regression test without network/tip thrash.
Failure mode: A lean that only restates "defer clears blocks" can ship green while wall-clock stays scan-first. Soft-pass alone re-binds the refuted premise under a different sentence.
Disposition: Acceptance and the bind lean must require a regression that proves defer skips (or TTL-hits) discovery without tip thrash — not merely that `blocks` is false.

## Tip residue amplifies cost; clearing it does not fix defer semantics
footnote
Evidence: `discoverFinalizeOwed` scales with TIP_NONTERMINAL + completed tip paths and per-story claim probes. Issue body and current-state name `#635` / PR `#401` residue as a separate operator clear; this arc's non-goal is auto-deleting those briefs.
Failure mode: Emptying residue helps undeferred starts; deferred starts still pay full discovery until Prefer-A lands.
Disposition: Keep `#635` out of first-ship. Do not treat residue clearing as a substitute for defer short-circuit.

## Road-not-taken

TTL inventory under `.deft/` (issue option 2) would help undeferred concurrent leaves reuse one scan. Prefer-A skip-on-defer is the smaller first-ship and matches existing doctor/cache_fresh defer short-circuit. TTL can remain a later sharpening if undeferred stampede stays hot after Prefer-A.

## Steelmans

Strongest defense of the target: deferred starts should still print a live inventory so operators see owed residue even when mutation is allowed. That audit value already has `task swarm:finalize-owed` inventory/dry-run surfaces; session:start under an explicit deferral is the wrong place to force a multi-minute tip walk. Soft-pass-after-scan keeps the audit line while breaking the defer cost contract that sibling ritual deferrals already honor.

metadata.issueBody:
## Pain

Dest through-merge leaves (and parent `session:start --rearm`) spend ~10–15 minutes in `session:start` even when `--defer-owed=<reason>` is already on the argv. Operators see a five-leaf cohort "stuck in session:start" while each worktree re-runs the same tip finalize-owed inventory. Ceremony wall-clock dominates before any Bound-remedy code write.

Observed on deftai/directive 2026-09-29:
- Parent rearm with `--defer-owed=operator-other-agent-handles-635-finalize-owed` recorded success after **~894s**, mostly tip/finalize discovery.
- Concurrent dest leaves each invoked `session:start` with `--defer-owed=…` / `--defer=cache_fresh=…` and remained in ceremony for ~15 minutes.
- `#635` proposed briefs citing merged PR `#401` keep the inventory non-empty (false-positive owed shape); clearing that residue is tracked separately. This issue is the **gate cost when defer is already present**, plus dest ceremony shape.

## Desired outcome

1. **`--defer-owed` short-circuits the expensive probe** (or uses a short TTL cache), so defer means skip/reuse work — not "scan fully, then soft-pass."
2. **Dest leaf ceremony prefers cheap rearm / shared cache** when a ritual already exists, and does not stampede N cold tip inventories against the same delivery tip.

## Bound direction (product)

### A. Defer skips or caches owed discovery (#4919 follow-on)

Today `evaluateFinalizeOwedSessionGate` still calls `discoverFinalizeOwed` (tip fetch + nonterminal walk + PR admit) before applying `deferOwedReason`. Defer only clears `blocks`; it does not clear the wall-clock.

Fix options (prefer smallest):
- When `deferOwedReason` is non-empty, **do not** call `discoverFinalizeOwed` / `fetchDeliveryTipPrivate` for the blocking inventory path; record deferred lines + ritual `finalize_owed` soft state and continue.
- Or: persist last inventory under `.deft/` with a short TTL; concurrent dest `session:start` reuse it; defer still skips refresh when reason is present.

Do not weaken the fail-closed owed gate for undeferred starts. Empty/non-blocking inventory should stay a fast path either way.

### B. Dest leaf ceremony (swarm / Grok through-merge)

Document and/or teach leaves (swarm skill / host-grok-build / preamble):
- Prefer `session:start --rearm` when dest `.deft/ritual-state.json` already exists.
- Keep `--defer-owed=<reason>` and `--defer=cache_fresh=…` as audited soft paths.
- Avoid launching N dest cold `session:start` tip inventories at once while the gate is still scan-first (serialize ceremony, or wait for A).
- Primary ritual does not satisfy dest worktree hooks — dest still needs its own ritual, but it should not re-pay full owed discovery when defer/cache applies.

## Non-goals

- Raising `session:start` timeouts or hang-detector budgets to hide the scan.
- Auto-deleting or cancelling the `#635` proposed briefs (handled by a separate operator agent).
- Reopening anonymous occupancy release / `#3954` doctrine.

## Acceptance

- With `--defer-owed=<reason>`, `session:start` / `--rearm` on a tip that would otherwise block completes in seconds-class time (no full `discoverFinalizeOwed` tip walk), and ritual records the deferred reason.
- Without defer, blocking owed inventory still fail-closes with the existing remediation text.
- Dest through-merge leaf guidance (skill or preamble) prefers `--rearm` when dest ritual exists and documents defer/cache_fresh; a five-leaf cohort does not require five full cold owed tip scans when defer is set.
